content: It's now Day 4. The rockslide clears on the morning of day 5. The only route to the shrine is through (11,4), which is blocked until then. Let me record this and wait until day 5 morning.

args.note: The Old Shrine chest at Meadow (11,1) is only reachable via the single gap at (11,3)-(11,4); the rockslide at (11,4) blocks it until the repair crew clears it on the morning of day 5.
